title: Every browser tab and bookmark in DR1 reads "Page - Import notification service - GOV.UK"; the frontend drops the GOV.UK suffix and joins with a pipe.

finding.frontend: The browser tab, the bookmark and the screen-reader announcement of every page read "Origin of the import | Import notification service" — page name, a pipe, service name, and nothing more. All 33 captured screens follow it, because it is composed once at src/server/app/shared/layout.njk:17. Nothing identifies the page as a GOV.UK service in the tab, and the pipe is not the separator the rest of GOV.UK uses. The one thing the frontend does that DR1 does not is prefix the title with "Error: " when the page is showing validation errors, which is the documented GOV.UK behaviour and should survive any change here.
finding.prototype: DR1 titles every page "Origin of the import - Import notification service - GOV.UK" — page name, service name and GOV.UK, joined by hyphens. All 40 captured screens use it. Each view supplies only its own page name (app/views/origin-of-the-import.html:11 sets "Origin of the import") and the surrounding format is composed once for the whole prototype.
finding.difference: Change the title composition at src/server/app/shared/layout.njk:17 to join the page name, the service name and "GOV.UK" with hyphens, keeping the existing "Error: " prefix in front of the whole thing. Feature copy does not change — every page already supplies just its own name. Any spec that asserts on a full page title will need updating. Worth saying plainly what this rests on: unlike the phase banner and the navigation bar, this format is the Prototype Kit's default composition rather than something DR1's designers wrote, so DR1 is weak evidence on its own. It is worth doing because it is also the GOV.UK Design System's documented title convention, which the frontend's pipe form is not.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding any frontend page whose title ends in "- GOV.UK", or any DR1 page whose title uses a pipe.
finding.correction: Claim sound; one field fixed. Counts re-derived from the page models: all 33 frontend titles are "<page> | Import notification service" and all 40 DR1 titles are "<page> - Import notification service - GOV.UK", with no exception on either side. The caveat the finding volunteers is exactly right and now has a line behind it: the format is composed by the Prototype Kit at govuk-prototype-kit/layouts/govuk-branded.njk:24, `{% if pageName %}{{ pageName }} - {% endif %}{{ serviceName }} - GOV.UK`, and DR1's views supply only `pageName`, so DR1 states nothing here and the case rests on the GOV.UK Design System convention alone. It still stands as one finding rather than a nit: it is a single change to one line of the shared layout, and what it changes is what a user reads in the tab, the bookmark and the screen-reader page announcement of all 33 pages. The "Error: " prefix is confirmed present in the frontend (src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:12, with a Welsh pair) and absent from DR1's error captures, and keeping it is right: the Design System asks for that prefix whenever an error summary is shown, so on this one point the frontend follows GOV.UK and DR1 does not. The `controls` entry was the title string written as a visible label; a page title is not an element on the page, so the crop would have found nothing. Set to an empty array, which the contract reads as a stated whole-page choice.
